pair_trading_sol_ltc.economic_verdict: Two-leg dollar-neutral pair trading achieves lower volatility and protected drawdowns (MDD 11.2%), but due to out-of-sample spread drift and Bybit VIP0 friction (14 bps roundtrip across 2 legs), the strategy delivers only -0.0028% mean net daily return, failing the mandatory >= 3.00% daily return gate.

single_slot_directional_rs.economic_verdict: Single-slot directional relative strength captures higher beta during momentum runs but suffers catastrophic drawdowns (MDD 55.65%) when the market reverses, violating the mandatory <= 15.0% maximum drawdown gate.
